\begin{lexlean}{Studio.Observer}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.bool@1.2.0}
\useglossary{lexlean.std.nat@1.2.0}
\importmodule{Studio.Runtime}
\importmodule{Studio.User}
\title{Natural number addition}
\begin{semanticmodule}
definition{
  name: prismId,
  parameters: [name : Bytes],
  result: Bool,
  body: (((prim length 0x707269736d3a : Nat) <? (prim length name : Nat)) && (Studio.User::begins name 0x707269736d3a)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: article,
  parameters: [kind : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (if (Studio.User::human kind) then 0x6120 else 0x616e20),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: observation,
  parameters: [participant : Bytes, kind : Bytes, journey : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x6f62736572766564206279207468652056657264616e74204f627365727665723a206120736f73613a4f62736572766174696f6e206f662074686520 journey : Bytes) (prim append 0x206a6f75726e65792c2070726f763a7761734173736f6369617465645769746820 participant : Bytes) : Bytes) (prim append (prim append (prim append 0x2c20 (article kind) : Bytes) (prim append kind 0x207061727469636970616e742c207468726f75676820 : Bytes) : Bytes) (prim append (Studio.User::channel kind journey) 0x0a : Bytes) : Bytes) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: observationOf,
  parameters: [participant : Bytes, value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons verb f1 => (match f1
      | List.cons kind f2 => (match f2
        | List.cons journey f3 => (if (Studio.User::known kind) then (observation participant kind journey) else 0x)
        | List.nil => 0x)
      | List.nil => 0x)
    | List.nil => 0x),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: observe,
  parameters: [participant : Bytes, value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (observationOf participant value) (Studio.User::request value) : Bytes),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: participantRefusal,
  parameters: [name : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (prim append (prim append 0x726566757365643a20 name : Bytes) 0x206973206e6f20507269736d2049442c20736f207468652056657264616e74204f62736572766572206173736f63696174657320697473206f62736572766174696f6e2077697468206e6f207061727469636970616e743b206e616d65206f6e6520617320707269736d3a20616e6420697473206e616d65 : Bytes)
}

definition{
  name: request,
  parameters: [value : Bytes],
  result: Bytes,
  body: (match (Studio.Runtime::split value 9)
    | List.cons participant rest => (if (prismId participant) then (observe participant (Studio.User::joinTabs rest)) else (participantRefusal participant))
    | List.nil => 0x696e76616c69642072657175657374),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: observing_never_changes_what_a_participant_experiences,
  parameters: [participant : Bytes, value : Bytes],
  statement: ((observe participant value) = (prim append (observationOf participant value) (Studio.User::request value) : Bytes)),
  proof: reflexivity{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: observes_an_agent_as_a_participant,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: observes_a_person_as_a_participant,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = ),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

theorem{
  name: refuses_a_participant_with_no_prism_id,
  parameters: [],
  statement: ((request ) = 0x726566757365643a20616c6578206973206e6f20507269736d2049442c20736f207468652056657264616e74204f62736572766572206173736f63696174657320697473206f62736572766174696f6e2077697468206e6f207061727469636970616e743b206e616d65206f6e6520617320707269736d3a20616e6420697473206e616d65),
  proof: decide{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
\end{semanticmodule}
\end{lexlean}
